messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] 23:04 UTC — Canary rollout rlv2-ratecap v3 -> v4 in us-west-2 reporting 5xx/429 spike; auto-canary-slowdown triggered
sara (oncall): Paging: I'm on it. seeing 429s in the metrics dashboard for routes with exemptions (internal-admin, billing-webhooks). logs show 'quota_exempt=false' where it should be true.
mike (eng-runtime): omg, I see the same in traces — requests that should be exempt are hitting the new rate-cap codepath. dump of token headers:
```
old: X-Client-Token: abc123
new: X-Rw-Token: abc123
```
rlv2 was reading X-Client-Token; v4 reads X-Rw-Token. missing mapping for legacy header in canary config.
jordan (sre): This matches the token-accounting change in the rollout. Canary config didn't include backward-compat header mapper. Impact: internal autoscaled services got throttled and 3 customer sessions rated as degraded.
sara (oncall): Impact assessment: 11 endpoints showed increased 429 rate (peak 18%); customer-facing error reports: 2 high-priority tickets, multiple timeouts in dashboards. no data loss.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0523 — canary-ratecap-exemption-failure — severity: high — paged oncall
sara (oncall): Early mitigation — disabling new canary route in us-west-2. Running: /deploy rollback rlv2-ratecap v3 --region us-west-2 --reason "exempt header mapping missing"
mike (eng-runtime): Rolling back canary now. command output:
```
> rollback started
> taking canary out of rotation: rlv2-ratecap:v4 (instance ids [i-0a4ef,...])
> confirm: health checks back to baseline
```
sara (oncall): Canaries out, 429s dropping. Monitoring.
tina (support): Logged a proactive note to CS for customers with webhooks; pinging affected accounts: acme-corp, fintech-labs.
kevin (pm): How did this slip through canary gating? We had tests for header compat. any quick root cause?
mike (eng-runtime): Root cause: new kernel picks header name X-Rw-Token; migration added acceptance for new header but the canary manifest omitted the compatibility mapping due to a templating bug in deploy pipeline. unit tests passed because they mock token extraction from new header only.
jordan (sre): Mitigation steps
- rollback canary (done)
- patch canary manifest to include header mapper
- redeploy a corrected canary behind a stricter health gate (no auto-fallback until 1h stable)
- add integration test that includes legacy header name
sara (oncall): I'll hand off to mike for the followups; my next meeting in 10m. tagging @mike as new oncall owner.
mike (eng-runtime): Taking over. I'll push a hotfix to manifest in the staging pipeline, run an end-to-end with both headers, and then reattempt a limited canary.
mike (eng-runtime): Fast fix pushed: add headerMapping { "X-Client-Token": "X-Rw-Token" } to canary template. CI green. kicking small canary (2 instances) with trace sampling enabled.
ops-bot: Deploy event: rlv2-ratecap v4 -> canary (2/2) — health OK after 7m — sampling shows no exemption regressions for a 10k request batch.
sara (oncall): Thanks. Note for postmortem: include timeline, the templating bug, missing integ test, and a runbook item to check header mappings when modifying token headers. Please include customer impact summary and CS followups.
tina (support): CS contacted acme-corp; they reported 3 failed webhook retries during window. Provided mitigation steps and ETA for final safe redeploy.
kevin (pm): Also recommend a small UI/console flag: 'compat header mappings' visible in canary config, to avoid silent omission.
mike (eng-runtime): Agreed. I'll add a lint that fails deploy if token header rename occurs without explicit mapping. Will link PR in follow-up.
jordan (sre): Closing immediate incident ticket once metrics show stable 24h. For now set severity -> monitoring and watch for any resurgence during next 2 deploys.
sara (oncall): Handing back to mike; I'll remain reachable. Good job team. :thumbsup:
mike (eng-runtime): Thanks — will run the post-deploy evaluation tonight and open postmortem draft.
ops-bot: Update: incident INC-2026-0523 status -> mitigated. last action: canary rollback + header-mapping hotfix
kevin (pm): Add note: retrospective: tighten canary health gating for anything touching token/auth headers. high risk.
